title: Create a 360° animation for shoes
h1: Make a 360° animation for shoes in 9 steps 👠
description: Create a 360 shoe animation in 9 steps. Enhance your e-commerce visuals with interactive and immersive rendering.
duration: 1 to 5 minutes for a complete animation
tool: Canon EOS R5 SLR, Orbitvu Station software and a pump (or other)
logistics: Alphashot XL Pro with integrated turntable
introText:
In this tutorial, our experts guide you step by step to create a 360° animation of shoes. 👠

Thanks to an assembly of 24 to 360 photographs, it is possible to design a immersive animation, ideal for showcasing your shoe collections whether sneakers, boots or street shoes on an e-commerce site. 💻

This interactive and dynamic format offers your visitors the unique opportunity to examine the product from every angle, revealing every detail, even the most subtle. With this technology, your customers can explore the product as if they had it in their hands.

Result: a comprehensive and immersive presentation that inspires confidence, reinforces engagement and greatly facilitates the purchase decision. 💳

And good news, a single shoe or product is enough to create a quality 360° animation.

Also discover our tutorial on multi-angle shoe photography.

steps.title: On your marks: clean your shoe
steps.content:
🧽Depending on the material of the shoe, use a rag or brush to remove all traces of dust.

💨 On a suede pump, we recommend using a dust remover aerosol.

Some shoe models made of leather or soft fabric require a paper upholstery to keep their shape when shooting in the studio.
steps.structuredText: Depending on the material of the shoe, use a rag or brush to remove any traces of dust. On a suede pump, we recommend using a dusting spray. Some shoe models made of leather or soft fabric require paper padding to keep their shape during studio shooting.

steps.title: Position it in your photo studio (0'30 minutes)
steps.content:
📍 Place the pump In profile in the studio, in the center of the turntable using the coordinate system located in the center of the turntable or trigger The positioning laser from the software. For this tutorial we used Orbitvu's Alphashot XL studio, which is the most suitable for shooting shoes.

Once your shoe is perfectly centered, create a Phantom image. The exact position of the pump is stored by the software on a profile. This phantom image will later be used to make it easier for you to position similar products.

On a thin heel pump, use a small Tip of paste to fix to prevent any movement during the rotation of the platter. 🔄

steps.content:
✔ Set the ISO on a value between 200 and 400.

✔The opening out of 11 for completely clear photos.

steps.title: Ready? Choose the ideal lighting for your pump (1 minute)
steps.content:
Adjust the intensity of 6 different lighting sources Studio LEDs: front, rear, columns or even turntable backlighting. If you need inspiration, try the Templates by default.

You can also adjust the white balance to make the light warmer or colder, or leave it as it is.

✔ All Orbitvu studios are set to get the as natural light as possible by default (daylight).

steps.title: Before leaving the starting blocks (0'10 minutes)
steps.content:
Choose the direction of rotation, speed, and number of frames that will make up the 360° animation. It is possible to achieve up to 360 photos to get the smoothest animation possible.

For an e-commerce website, for example specialized in shoes, 24 photos are more than enough!

steps.content:
🎬 Start recording by clicking “Check-in”.

The board starts to rotate 360 degrees. During this rotation, the software automatically calculates the angles and the camera photographs your shoe 24 times.

faqs.question: Why use 360° animation for shoes?
faqs.answer: The 360° animations offer a unique interactive experience that draws the attention of online customers. They allow you to visualize every detail of the shoes, such as the stitching, the textures or the finishes, which is impossible with traditional photos. Studies show that products presented in 360° increase conversion rates and reduce returns thanks to a better understanding of the product by the consumer.

faqs.question: Why is it important to save a configuration profile?
faqs.answer: Saving camera and lighting settings in a custom profile allows them to be reused during future photo shoots, ensuring visual consistency and considerable time savings.

faqs.question: How to quickly export visuals to e-commerce platforms or social networks?
faqs.answer: With Orbitvu Station, export your visuals directly to platforms like Shopify or other e-commerce sites. Thanks to Orbitvu Sun Cloud, easily generate integration links or QR codes to share animations on social networks or during marketing campaigns, ensuring quick and effective publication.

faqs.question: Is Orbitvu suitable for complex or luxury products?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Orbitvu solutions, like the Alphashot XL, are designed to accurately capture complex products, like high-end leather shoes or items with delicate textures. Tools like the iQ-mask and adjustable lighting options ensure flawless visuals for all types of materials and finishes.

faqs.question: What are the benefits for brands of using automated photography?
faqs.answer: Automated photography allows brands to save time, reduce production costs, and ensure consistent quality on all visuals. It integrates perfectly with digital workflows, facilitating the integration of visuals into e-commerce sites, social networks and marketing campaigns. It is an ideal solution to meet consumer expectations for interactive and immersive content.
